results.title: Two-finger pinch on the map zooms the camera
Chronicle of an unfinished solo game offers only the player's own view
Resizing mid-game keeps the projection complete (no unpainted world regions after the clip)
Age changes regrade the land and switch towns to their Twilight sprites (no stale render caches)
Reduced motion and Low quality keep a stable cue for every power without the world-light envelope
Staggered town rebuilds never leave an obsolete sprite: within a few frames of a state change every town shows its current sprite
Every one of the forty power effects ends: after a cast and four seconds of frames no effect objects remain
Weather lifecycle: every kind draws on the map, wind follows rain and storm, and nothing lingers once the front is gone
Site transitions: a shrine raised plays its choreography and caption; reduced motion keeps only the caption; a hot-seat hand-off plays nothing
Art registry coverage: every icon, emblem, pattern, event scene (three ages) and terrain family renders non-empty at its interface size
Drawing order: terrain features always lie under towns, shrines and priests (a range in front never hides a town)
Town life is visual only: it draws only at towns the viewer has revealed and leaves the game state byte-for-byte unchanged
